origin.summary: The owner authorized continued development after PL-0040; M-11 is dependency-ready because C-09 is complete, while the current verifier does not prove one atomic 2D/3D selection round trip and repeated-selection suppression as a single regression matrix.

state.current_summary: M-11 is closed on the existing Inspection Workspace verifier: the current 67/67 matrix proves one change per distinct linked-view selection, zero changes for repeats, stable recipe/execution state, and an exact existing-CI report gate.

objective.summary: Close M-11 with deterministic evidence that Height Image and 3D Viewer selection adapters converge on one recipe selection without duplicate selection events or inspection execution.
constraints: Reuse InspectionWorkspaceSelectionVerification, SelectPipelineStepForSelection, HeightImageRoiWorkspaceViewModel, and the existing --verify-inspection-workspace-selection command; create no second synchronization owner or test framework.
Do not change production selection behavior, UI layout/style/text, recipe/schema/version, Preview/Publish/Run semantics, R0, or release state.
Prove exact selection-change counts, case-insensitive repeated selection suppression, stable selection cardinality, and no dirty/route/state/output mutation.
Keep all generated reports and temporary data D-backed and preserve the existing headless CI command while adding only a complete-report assertion.

criteria.text: A simulated 3D Viewer adapter selection and an actual Height Image ROI selection each resolve the same recipe-owned role and identity through SelectPipelineStepForSelection with exactly one atomic selection change.
Repeating either cross-view selection with identical or case-varied identity emits no duplicate selection change and retains exactly one instance of each authored selection.
The complete 3D-to-Height-Image round trip leaves dirty state, route, step state, Preview, measurement output, and authored geometry unchanged.
The existing CI Workbench command remains the execution owner and rejects a passing but incomplete cross-view case matrix by checking the exact current report total.

Focused Release verification, full Release build, standard test facade, NuGet health, structure, fixed Vision SDK package boundary, issue validation, documentation links, transient cleanup, and diff hygiene pass.

context.summary: Existing 64-case WPF-neutral Inspection Workspace selection and ROI lifecycle verifier.
SelectPipelineStepForSelection is already called by both linked-view adapters.
Current Workbench contracts already invoke --verify-inspection-workspace-selection after build.

evidence.observation: The current existing verifier passed 67/67. Its linked-view cases recorded one SelectionChanged event for Reference through the shared 3D adapter route, no additional event for a case-varied repeat, one additional event for Measurement through the Height Image pointer request, and no event for the repeated Height Image selection. Selection count/geometry, dirty state, route, Ready step state, Preview state, and null measurement output remained unchanged.

The existing current-Workbench CI step still invokes --verify-inspection-workspace-selection after build and now throws unless the report contains Result: Pass (67/67 checks); adjacent verifier commands are unchanged.

Current-tree checks passed: focused Shell and full 15-project Release builds with zero warnings/errors, final Inspection Workspace 67/67, standard facade 2/2, NuGet vulnerable/deprecated findings 0/0, structure 68/68, fixed Vision SDK package identity/checksum, documentation targets present, zero transient fixture roots/C3D files, issue validation, and diff hygiene. The headless verifier created no WPF window; hosted CI was not run.
